Indonesian: Manna Pagi

Indonesian: Tips hari ini

English: Good morning, pilgrim! Here is something for today.
Indonesian: Selamat pagi, musafir! Ini sesuatu untuk hari ini.

English: Welcome back, pilgrim! Here is something for today.
Indonesian: Selamat datang kembali, musafir! Ini sesuatu untuk hari ini.

Indonesian: Petunjuk

English: Tip
Indonesian: Tips

Indonesian: Sebuah Janji

English: Did you know?
Indonesian: Tahukah kamu?

English: Pilgrim's Path
Indonesian: Jalan Musafir

English: {n} of 7 stones lit. Come back tomorrow for the next one!
Indonesian: {n} dari 7 batu menyala. Datang lagi besok untuk batu berikutnya!

English: All 7 stones are lit! A new path starts tomorrow.
Indonesian: Ketujuh batu menyala! Besok jalan baru dimulai.

English: A gift for your full path: the {name} lantern!
Indonesian: Hadiah untuk jalan penuhmu: lentera {name}!

English: Today's little quest
Indonesian: Misi kecil hari ini

English: Find a Promise scroll.
Indonesian: Temukan gulungan Janji.

English: Read at a waystone.
Indonesian: Baca di batu penunjuk jalan.

English: Have 3 talks with friends.
Indonesian: Bicara 3 kali dengan teman.

English: Jump 10 times.
Indonesian: Lompat 10 kali.

English: Read a Promise in your Satchel.
Indonesian: Baca sebuah Janji di tasmu.

English: {n} of {total}
Indonesian: {n} dari {total}

English: Done!
Indonesian: Selesai!

English: Quest done! Today's stone shines gold.
Indonesian: Misi selesai! Batu hari ini bersinar emas.

English: Welcome back! The Way missed you.
Indonesian: Selamat datang kembali! Jalan ini merindukanmu.

English: Your lantern
Indonesian: Lenteramu

Indonesian: Emas

English: Rose
Indonesian: Mawar

English: Sky
Indonesian: Langit

English: Mint
Indonesian: Mint

English: Violet
Indonesian: Ungu

English: Dawn
Indonesian: Fajar

English: Ember
Indonesian: Bara

English: LET'S GO
Indonesian: AYO BERANGKAT

English: The map is resting until tomorrow. Unlock the full journey to open it any time.
Indonesian: Peta sedang beristirahat sampai besok. Buka seluruh perjalanan untuk membukanya kapan saja.

English: Unlock the full journey
Indonesian: Buka seluruh perjalanan

English: Read the Roll at a waystone to save your journey and brighten your lantern.
Indonesian: Baca Gulungan di batu penunjuk jalan untuk menyimpan perjalanan dan menerangi lenteramu.

English: Lantern getting low? Open your Satchel and read a Promise.
Indonesian: Lenteramu meredup? Buka tasmu dan baca sebuah Janji.

English: The bright, warm path is the Way. Side paths look fun, but they always cost something.
Indonesian: Jalan yang terang dan hangat adalah Jalan yang benar. Jalan samping tampak seru, tapi selalu ada harganya.

English: Lost? Follow the golden arrow. It always points along the Way.
Indonesian: Tersesat? Ikuti panah emas. Panah itu selalu menunjuk Jalan.

English: Promises often hide a little off the path, behind a small challenge.
Indonesian: Janji sering tersembunyi sedikit di luar jalan, di balik tantangan kecil.

English: Open your Satchel to see the friends you have met and what each name means.
Indonesian: Buka tasmu untuk melihat teman yang sudah kamu temui dan arti setiap nama.

English: Fell in a hole? No worries. You pop right back on the Way.
Indonesian: Jatuh ke lubang? Tenang saja. Kamu langsung kembali ke Jalan.

English: Once you can pray, prayer fills your lantern and lights the path ahead.
Indonesian: Setelah kamu bisa berdoa, doa mengisi lenteramu dan menerangi jalan di depan.

English: With the shield, block just as a dart arrives to bounce it back.
Indonesian: Dengan perisai, tangkis tepat saat panah datang supaya panah memantul balik.

English: Talk to everyone you meet. Some friends cheer you up when your lantern is low.
Indonesian: Bicaralah dengan semua orang. Beberapa teman menyemangatimu saat lenteramu redup.

English: John Bunyan wrote much of The Pilgrim's Progress while he was in prison in Bedford, England.
Indonesian: John Bunyan menulis sebagian besar The Pilgrim's Progress saat ia dipenjara di Bedford, Inggris.

English: The Pilgrim's Progress was first printed in 1678, almost 350 years ago.
Indonesian: The Pilgrim's Progress pertama kali dicetak tahun 1678, hampir 350 tahun lalu.

English: The Pilgrim's Progress has been translated into more than 200 languages.
Indonesian: The Pilgrim's Progress sudah diterjemahkan ke lebih dari 200 bahasa.

English: Before he wrote books, John Bunyan was a tinker who mended pots and pans.
Indonesian: Sebelum menulis buku, John Bunyan adalah tukang patri yang memperbaiki panci dan wajan.

English: Every name in the story tells you about the person. Pliable bends easily, and Obstinate never changes his mind.
Indonesian: Setiap nama dalam cerita ini menjelaskan orangnya. Plin-Plan mudah berubah, dan Keras Kepala tidak pernah berubah pikiran.

English: Bunyan wrote a second part, about Christiana and her four boys going on the same journey.
Indonesian: Bunyan menulis bagian kedua, tentang Christiana dan keempat putranya dalam perjalanan yang sama.

English: The whole story is told as a dream. It begins, "I dreamed a dream."
Indonesian: Seluruh cerita dikisahkan sebagai mimpi. Cerita itu dimulai dengan, "Aku bermimpi."

English: "Slough" is an old English word for a deep, muddy bog.
Indonesian: "Slough" adalah kata Inggris kuno untuk rawa yang dalam dan berlumpur.

English: Every model, sound and tune in this game was made by our own code.
Indonesian: Setiap model, suara, dan lagu di game ini dibuat dengan kode kami sendiri.

English: Vanity Fair is named for "vanity": things that look shiny but do not last.
Indonesian: Pasar Raya Sia-sia dinamai dari "kesia-siaan": hal-hal yang berkilau tapi tidak bertahan.

English: Read the glowing Book, then go out of the town gate to meet Evangelist.
Indonesian: Baca Buku yang bercahaya, lalu keluar dari gerbang kota untuk bertemu Penginjil.

English: Follow the tiny shining light far away on the horizon.
Indonesian: Ikuti cahaya kecil yang bersinar jauh di cakrawala.

English: In the bog, running makes you sink faster. Walk slowly.
Indonesian: Di rawa, berlari membuatmu tenggelam lebih cepat. Berjalanlah pelan-pelan.

English: Stand still in the mud for two seconds, and hidden stepping stones glow.
Indonesian: Diamlah dua detik di lumpur, dan batu pijakan tersembunyi akan bersinar.

English: The smooth sunny road is not the Way. Keep to the narrow path.
Indonesian: Jalan mulus yang cerah itu bukan Jalan yang benar. Tetaplah di jalan yang sempit.

English: If the mountain rumbles and flashes, you have left the Way.
Indonesian: Kalau gunung bergemuruh dan berkilat, kamu sudah keluar dari Jalan.

English: A red line on the ground shows where arrows will land. Step away!
Indonesian: Garis merah di tanah menunjukkan tempat panah akan jatuh. Menyingkirlah!

English: Hide behind the rocks between volleys, then knock on the gate.
Indonesian: Bersembunyilah di balik batu di antara hujan panah, lalu ketuk gerbangnya.

English: Each room in the Interpreter's House is a puzzle. Remember what it teaches!
Indonesian: Setiap ruangan di Rumah Penafsir adalah teka-teki. Ingat pelajarannya!

English: In the dusty room, a broom only makes it worse. Try the water jug.
Indonesian: Di ruangan berdebu, sapu justru memperburuk keadaan. Coba kendi air.

English: Climb the hill to the cross and see what happens to the Burden.
Indonesian: Daki bukit sampai ke salib dan lihat apa yang terjadi pada Beban.

English: After the cross, try three joy jumps in the meadow!
Indonesian: Setelah salib, coba tiga lompatan gembira di padang rumput!

English: Near the lions, keep to the middle of the path. Their chains hold them back.
Indonesian: Di dekat singa, tetaplah di tengah jalan. Rantai mereka menahan mereka.

English: Resting in the arbour is nice, but watch out for your Roll.
Indonesian: Beristirahat di punjung memang nyaman, tapi jaga Gulunganmu.

English: Block the glowing paw with your shield, then strike the glowing belly.
Indonesian: Tangkis cakar yang bersinar dengan perisai, lalu pukul perut yang bersinar.

English: A perfect block bounces the fiery darts back.
Indonesian: Tangkisan sempurna memantulkan panah api kembali.

English: Shadows run away from prayer. Pray when they come close.
Indonesian: Bayangan lari dari doa. Berdoalah saat mereka mendekat.

English: Only prayer can push back the smoke at the smoking pit.
Indonesian: Hanya doa yang bisa mendorong asap di lubang berasap.

English: At the fair stalls, saying "No thank you" keeps you light.
Indonesian: Di kios-kios pasar, berkata "Tidak, terima kasih" membuatmu tetap ringan.

English: At night, stay out of the watchmen's lantern light.
Indonesian: Di malam hari, jauhi cahaya lentera para penjaga.

English: Stuck somewhere dark? Think about everything you were given along the Way.
Indonesian: Terjebak di tempat gelap? Pikirkan semua yang diberikan kepadamu di sepanjang Jalan.

English: When the giant comes, listen to Hopeful. His kind words help.
Indonesian: Saat raksasa datang, dengarkan Penuh Harap. Kata-katanya yang baik menolong.

English: A true guide points up to the Way. Beware of anyone who only flatters you.
Indonesian: Pemandu sejati menunjuk ke atas, ke Jalan. Waspadai orang yang hanya menyanjungmu.

English: On the Enchanted Ground, keep talking with Hopeful to stay awake.
Indonesian: Di Tanah Terpesona, terus berbicara dengan Penuh Harap supaya tetap terjaga.

English: In the river, pray to raise your Hope, and the water grows shallower.
Indonesian: Di sungai, berdoalah untuk menaikkan Harapanmu, dan airnya jadi lebih dangkal.

English: Keep your Roll safe. You will show it at the Gate.
Indonesian: Simpan Gulunganmu baik-baik. Kamu akan menunjukkannya di Gerbang.

English: Watch for a kind visitor who brings a special letter.
Indonesian: Perhatikan tamu baik hati yang membawa surat istimewa.

English: Every journey starts with one brave step.
Indonesian: Setiap perjalanan dimulai dengan satu langkah berani.

English: You are braver than you feel today.
Indonesian: Hari ini kamu lebih berani daripada yang kamu rasakan.

English: Small steps still move you forward.
Indonesian: Langkah kecil pun membawamu maju.

English: It's okay to fall. Pilgrims get up again.
Indonesian: Jatuh itu tidak apa-apa. Musafir bangkit lagi.

English: Be kind to someone today, like Help was kind to Christian.
Indonesian: Berbaik hatilah kepada seseorang hari ini, seperti Penolong kepada Christian.

English: You don't have to walk alone. Friends make the Way lighter.
Indonesian: Kamu tidak harus berjalan sendirian. Teman membuat Jalan terasa ringan.

English: Your Hope can grow a little brighter every day.
Indonesian: Harapanmu bisa bersinar sedikit lebih terang setiap hari.

English: Trying again is a kind of courage.
Indonesian: Mencoba lagi juga termasuk keberanian.

English: A thank-you can light up someone's whole day.
Indonesian: Ucapan terima kasih bisa menerangi hari seseorang.

English: Even a tiny light can push back the dark.
Indonesian: Cahaya kecil pun bisa mengusir gelap.

English: Mistakes help you learn the Way.
Indonesian: Kesalahan membantumu belajar tentang Jalan.

English: You are loved, just as you are.
Indonesian: Kamu dikasihi, apa adanya.

English: Share a smile. It costs nothing and gives a lot.
Indonesian: Bagikan senyuman. Gratis, tapi berarti banyak.

English: When something is hard, take one more step.
Indonesian: Saat sesuatu terasa sulit, ambil satu langkah lagi.

English: Faithful helped Christian up. Who can you help today?
Indonesian: Setia membantu Christian bangun. Siapa yang bisa kamu bantu hari ini?

English: Listen kindly, and you will make a friend.
Indonesian: Dengarkan dengan baik, dan kamu akan mendapat teman.

English: Be honest, even when it is hard.
Indonesian: Berkatalah jujur, walaupun sulit.

English: Rest is good. Then keep going!
Indonesian: Istirahat itu baik. Lalu lanjutkan!

English: Find something beautiful today and enjoy it.
Indonesian: Temukan sesuatu yang indah hari ini dan nikmatilah.

English: Patience is waiting with a happy heart.
Indonesian: Sabar artinya menunggu dengan hati gembira.

English: Saying sorry when you are wrong makes you strong.
Indonesian: Meminta maaf saat kamu salah membuatmu kuat.

English: Your words can build someone up.
Indonesian: Kata-katamu bisa menyemangati seseorang.

English: Hopeful never gave up on his friend. You can be that friend.
Indonesian: Penuh Harap tidak pernah meninggalkan temannya. Kamu bisa menjadi teman seperti itu.

English: Every day is a new page of your story.
Indonesian: Setiap hari adalah halaman baru dalam ceritamu.

English: Asking for help when you need it is brave too.
Indonesian: Meminta tolong saat kamu butuh juga termasuk berani.

English: Be the light someone else is looking for.
Indonesian: Jadilah cahaya yang sedang dicari orang lain.

English: Good choices are like stepping stones.
Indonesian: Pilihan yang baik seperti batu pijakan.

English: You can do hard things, one step at a time.
Indonesian: Kamu bisa melakukan hal sulit, selangkah demi selangkah.

English: Notice three good things today.
Indonesian: Perhatikan tiga hal baik hari ini.

English: Forgive, and your heart will feel lighter.
Indonesian: Maafkanlah, dan hatimu akan terasa lebih ringan.

English: The narrow Way is worth it. Keep walking!
Indonesian: Jalan yang sempit itu berharga. Teruslah berjalan!

English: For today
Indonesian: Untuk hari ini
